verdicts.title: Coherent sheaves on the stack of Langlands parameters
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We formulate a few conjectures on some hypothetical coherent sheaves on the stacks of arithmetic local Langlands parameters, including their roles played in the local-global compatibility in the Langlands program. We survey some known results as evidences of these conjectures.

verdicts.title: Galois Self-Dual Constacyclic Codes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Generalizing Euclidean inner product and Hermitian inner product, we introduce Galois inner products, and study the Galois self-dual constacyclic codes in a very general setting by a uniform method. The conditions for existence of Galois self-dual and isometrically Galois self-dual constacyclic codes are obtained. As consequences, the results on self-dual, iso-dual and Hermitian self-dual constacyclic codes are derived.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Galois self-dual constacyclic codes and Galois inner products in coding theory, with no mention of Poincare series, Langlands duality, communication matrices, or monochromatic rectangles. It shares only the word 'Galois' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Galois lines for normal elliptic space curves, II
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For each linearly normal elliptic curve $C$ in $\mathbb P^3$, we determine Galois lines and their arrangement. The results are as follows: the curve $C$ has just six $V_4$-lines and in case $j(C)=1$, it has eight $Z_4$-lines in addition. The $V_4$-lines form the edges of a tetrahedron, in case $j(C)=1$, for each vertex of the tetrahedron, there exist just two $Z_4$-lines passing through it. verdicts.title: Bent Rectangles
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study generalized regular bent functions using a representation by bent rectangles, that is, special matrices with restrictions on rows and columns. We describe affine transformations of bent rectangles, propose new biaffine and bilinear constructions, study partitions of a vector space into affine planes of the same dimension and use such partitions to build bent rectangles. We illustrate the concept of bent rectangles by examples for the Boolean case.

verdicts.title: Geometric triangulations and highly twisted links
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: It is conjectured that every cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold admits a geometric triangulation, i.e. it is decomposed into positive volume ideal hyperbolic tetrahedra. Here, we show that sufficiently highly twisted knots admit a geometric triangulation. In addition, by extending work of Gueritaud and Schleimer, we also give quantified versions of this result for infinite families of examples.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns geometric triangulations of cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds and highly twisted knots, with no mention of Poincaré series, Galois representations, communication complexity, or boolean functions.
